decided.singular: I picked days whose daily mean is about 4.7 or more (most are 5.3 or more) or whose daily max is about 6.7 or more, where the days around them have means of about 1.5-3. Day 316 is the highest of all (max 8.667, mean 6.417).
decided.recurrence: A few pairs of active days are about 27 days apart (137→164, 258→285, 285→312), but many others are not (for example 164→191 is quiet), so a numeric list alone can't separate a period from chance.
decided.quarter: Q2 has the most days with a mean of 4 or more (about 16, including 149-154 and 164), against about 10 in Q4, even though Q4 has the single largest day (316).

answer.guess: A 3-hourly geomagnetic activity index such as Kp (0-9, eight values per day) over one year.
